claims.text: The hotel is located in downtown DC at CityCenter.

findings.quote: Located in downtown DC at CityCenter , it is convenient to the most elevated shopping and dining options in DC.
findings.note: States the downtown DC location at CityCenter.

claims.text: The hotel is a few blocks from the Convention Center and a short walk to the White House.

findings.quote: The Conrad is a few blocks from the Convention Center and a short walk to the White House and several DC attractions.

claims.text: The building was designed by Herzog & de Meuron.

findings.quote: designed by Pritzker Prize Laureates Herzog & de Meuron
findings.note: Names Herzog & de Meuron as the architects.

claims.text: The building has an all-glass exterior.
The building is LEED Gold Certified.

findings.quote: as well as our LEED Gold Certified building
findings.note: Official site states LEED Gold certification.

claims.text: The lobby, check-in and main dining and lounging spaces are on the third floor.

findings.quote: The lobby, check-in and main dining and lounging spaces are located on the third floor, adding to the above-the-fray feel.

claims.text: Interiors firm Rottet Studio designed the rooms with a contemporary decor and a muted palette of whites, grays and light woods.

findings.quote: Interiors firm Rottet Studio has created 360 bright, airy rooms with a streamlined contemporary décor of modular furnishings and a muted color palette of whites, grays, and light woods
findings.note: Covers the firm, the contemporary decor and the palette.

claims.text: All rooms have marble bathrooms with double vanities, walk-in showers and Byredo bath amenities.

findings.quote: all rooms have marble bathrooms with double vanities, walk-in showers, and Byredo bath amenities

claims.text: Suites have extras like low-slung couches and fireplaces.

findings.quote: Suites have extras like low-slung couches and fireplaces

claims.text: Estuary, the signature restaurant on the third floor next to the atrium, serves breakfast, lunch and dinner overlooking the Park at CityCenterDC.

findings.quote: Estuary, our signature restaurant located on the third floor next to the atrium, offers breakfast, lunch and dinner served in the lounge and main dining room overlooking the Park at CityCenterDC.
findings.note: Covers the floor, the atrium location, the meals and the view.

claims.text: Sakura Club Ambassadors personalize the stay of Sakura Club guests.

findings.quote: Our Sakura Club Ambassadors ensure that your experience goes beyond top tier service by personalizing your entire stay.

claims.text: The gym has walls of windows.

findings.quote: There's a decent gym with walls of windows

claims.text: The contemporary art collection, curated by Tatar Art Projects, pays homage to the Washington Color School.

findings.quote: Take note of the hotels contemporary art collection, which has been curated by consulting firm Tatar Art Projects and pays homage to the city’s Washington Color School and other historic art movements.
findings.note: Covers the curator and the homage.

claims.text: Guests staying in a Sakura Club room or suite have complimentary access to the Sakura Club.

findings.quote: Guests staying in a Sakura Club room or suite enjoy complimentary access to the Sakura Club.

claims.text: A private Sakura Club chef prepares breakfast and dinner options in the club.

findings.quote: Crafted by our private Sakura Club chef, our culinary offerings include freshly made and convenient options for breakfast and dinner.
findings.note: A private chef prepares breakfast and dinner.

claims.text: Corner King rooms have a wraparound wall of windows.

findings.quote: Rooms to get are the Premium Corner King, which have a wraparound wall of windows.
findings.note: Corner King rooms have a wraparound wall of windows; the official site names the category Premier Corner King.

claims.text: Sakura Club access is not available as a Hilton Honors upgrade or as a Diamond member benefit.

findings.quote: Access is not available as a Hilton Honors upgrade or as part of the Hilton Honors Diamond member benefits.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack resort-style amenities.
